I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

That comes from a message Tobias posted in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27, a channel Pree is in. He wrote that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share in the channel.

Tobias's message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was answering Hollis's question about "Tobias's dealer account." I linked that to Marrow Fieldworks because a GBrain note says it's a dealer account that changed hands on Jan 5, 2026. My reply states the link as fact, though. I couldn't find a newer status on the ticket, so I suggested Pree check with Tobias before the customer call.
